regime_context: The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on Canada TSX (gate_helps=true). Big Banks dominate with high durability and crowding, but no directional rotation handoff is confirmed. Cross-sectional ranks are an attention lens, not alpha; macro narrative is coincident and not a per-theme trigger.
emerging_watch: Base Metals & Copper: watch for a confirmed handoff if its score closes within 0.2 of Big Banks or overtakes it, and durability rises above 0.5. Kill the watch if score falls below 0.6 or durability drops below 0.3 within 10 days.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks are the absolute-trend gate-eligible leader with strong durability (0.69) and full breadth, indicating a healthy uptrend. The gate’s validated risk-control edge supports staying with the trend, while crowding is a sizing caution, not a reason to fade the leader.
theses.dissent: Crowding and high ownership could amplify mean-reversion if a macro shock hits financials, and the trend could stall if rate expectations shift abruptly.

falsifier.text: If ZEB.TO closes below its 50-day simple moving average for 3 consecutive days, or Big Banks’ durability_bar drops below 0.5 for 3 consecutive days.

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology failed the absolute-trend gate (eligible=false), meaning the trend filter does not support a healthy uptrend. Avoiding it aligns with the detector’s only validated edge—drawdown and shake-out control.
theses.dissent: Technology could rally sharply on AI-driven sentiment, but the trend gate currently flags it as not in a confirmed uptrend; waiting for eligibility to return avoids potential drawdowns.

falsifier.text: If Technology becomes eligible (durability_bar > 0.5) for 5 consecutive days and its rank rises into the top 5.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers are gate-eligible but exhibit mean-reverting dynamics (hurst_tag) and crowding, suggesting fragile trend persistence. An underweight lean reflects reduced confidence in trend continuation, not a fade or short.
theses.dissent: Energy prices could break out on supply disruption, extending the uptrend; the mean-revert signal is coincident, not a timing tool.

falsifier.text: If XEG.TO breaks above its 52-week high and the hurst status flips to ‘trending’, or durability_bar rises above 0.75.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
